name: List Landing Pages
summary: Browses the landing pages in your Marketo instance — name, ID, folder, status, and URL.
whenToUse: When you need to find a landing page's ID or see which pages exist (and their approval status).

query.name: status
query.label: Status
query.hint: Only approved pages, or only drafts.

query.name: maxReturn
query.label: Max to return
query.hint: How many pages to return. Default 20, maximum 200.

query.name: offset
query.label: Offset
query.hint: Start here when paging (with 'Max to return'). Default 0.

response.description: Landing page records: id, name, status, folder, URL, template, workspace, …

notes: Standard Asset API browse pattern (status / maxReturn / offset), as documented on the Emails and Smart Campaigns pages.
